title: Local client packages and configuration
objective: Publish tested local client configuration for independent MCP clients without changing runtime authority: Claude Desktop extension and config, Codex and ChatGPT local plugin configuration where supported, Mistral Vibe Code stdio and Streamable HTTP configuration, and generic MCP client examples with inspector qualification.

include: Claude Desktop configuration and Desktop Extension packaging where supported
Codex and ChatGPT local MCP configuration using cotra mcp stdio
Mistral Vibe Code stdio and loopback HTTP configuration
generic MCP client configuration and MCP inspector qualification
client package contract tests proving examples reference only supported entrypoints
exclude: any new MCP tool, tool schema change, capability widening, approval change, or authority change
any public provider submission, directory publication, or availability claim
any P15 remote relay, OAuth, device uplink, or public edge code
any P16 tool-surface widening or provider submission

invariants: authoritative builder remains the single tool source of truth
client packages add no independent tool authority
examples reference only supported installed entrypoints
no tunnel requirement for local clients

acceptance.claim: Tested configuration packages exist for Claude Desktop, Codex, Mistral Vibe Code, and generic MCP clients.
At least three independent local MCP clients use Cotra with identical policy and approval behavior across transports.
Contract tests prove examples reference only supported entrypoints, and all closed SG-000001 through SG-000050 regressions pass unchanged.
Exact-head CI including release qualification and supply-chain audit, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.p14_exit: COTRA-P14 exits only after SG-000051 closes with local clients qualified on stdio and loopback without new OS authority.

done_when: Local client packages are canonical with multi-client qualification and no authority change.
